title: Idea priority queue
description: docs/00-working/ideas-priority.yaml. A plain ordered list of idea IDs that jump the queue, sitting beside the append-only idea log (schemas/idea.schema.json) rather than inside it — the same shape as backlog.yaml's next_up. Reordering is a hand-edited operational decision, not a logged event: git history is the audit trail. Every listed idea must actually exist in _data/ideas.jsonl and be open or triaged; that cross-file check happens in governance, not here.

updated.description: Date this file was last reordered. Must not be in the future.

next_up.description: Idea IDs that jump the queue, in order. Everything else falls back to status (open before triaged) then ID.
